answer: Fake votes can ripple through AI harbor-to-summit freight dispatch. Proposed rule: each key earns one daily vote for a distinct 100-kg delivery. Validators check both depots' signed, key-bound weight receipts and reject reuse; failed checks mean no vote. Trucks are reusable capital; fuel and handling recur, with no locked stake. Batching cuts marginal cost; colluding depots can invent deliveries, so this is not proof of distinct owners. With honest depots, ten voting keys require 1 tonne delivered, whether using shared trucks or parallel trips.
